_comment: the defaults). Written by chezmoi on the m0 hub only, the one host that reads
it. The two commands run on spokes: provision_command after the plugin's own
setup when the golden image is built, sync_command on every spoke creation and
`spoke sync`. Both bring these dotfiles along; without them a spoke would
get the plugin, the harnesses and nothing personal. chezmoi is pinned to the
same version on every Linux host (docs/machine0-herdr.md).
provision_command: test -d ~/dotfiles || git clone -q https://github.com/justmytwospence/dotfiles.git ~/dotfiles; test -x ~/.local/bin/chezmoi || sh -c "$(curl -fsLS get.chezmoi.io)" -- -b ~/.local/bin -t v2.73.0; ~/.local/bin/chezmoi init --source ~/dotfiles --apply --force --no-tty --promptChoice host=m0-spoke --promptString extras=
